content.english: Give thanks to the God of knowledge,
Who performs miracles,
On this day, which is for a sign –

content.hebrew: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Pesaḥ hu ladonai: Pesaḥ hu ladonai.
content.english: It is Passover! Passover for Adonai!
As a commemoration of his kindness
To the nation of his inheritance,
God commanded his commandment –

content.hebrew: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Pesaḥ hu ladonai. Pesaḥ hu ladonai.
content.english: It is Passover! Passover for Adonai!
To establish his uniqueness,
That there is none other than him,
Just he alone.

content.hebrew: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Pesaḥ hu ladonai. Pesaḥ hu ladonai.
content.english: It is Passover! Passover for Adonai!
The rock (God) strengthened the faith
For those that know understanding.
From year to year –

content.hebrew: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Pesaḥ hu ladonai. Pesaḥ hu ladonai.
content.english: It is Passover! Passover for Adonai!
A memorial, for the Hebrews,
For all generations;
With unleavened bread and bitter herbs –

content.hebrew: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Pesaḥ hu ladonai. Pesaḥ hu ladonai.
content.english: It is Passover! Passover for Adonai!
The rock of ages (God) sanctified
The seven days,
From the time when the blood was applied [of the paschal sacrifice in Egypt] –

content.hebrew: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה: פֶּסַח הוּא לַיהֹוָה:
content.transliteration: Pesaḥ hu ladonai. Pesaḥ hu ladonai.
content.english: It is Passover! Passover for Adonai!
